paite: Israel ka sukdam chiangin, huaichiangin Ephraim thulimlouhna muhkhiak ahi, Samari gitlouhna toh; juauthei lah ahi ngal ua: huan, guta a luta, a po lamah suamhat pawlten a lok uh.
english: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

paite: A gitlouhna tengteng uh ka theigige chih a lungtangte un a ngaihtuah kei uh: tuin amau thilhihte ngeiin amaute a kainok hi; ka mai maah a om uh.
english: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

paite: A gitlouhna un a kumpipa uh a kipaksak ua, a juau un a lal uh.
english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

paite: A vek un angkawmte ahi uh; banghiam kangmiin silngouin a zelh suah masiah, tangbuang mekman jiaka mei sawn a tawp san thuk bang.
english: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

paite: I kumpipa uh niin lalte uain sain amau leh amau a kichinasak ua; simmohhatte toh a khut a zankhia.
english: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

paite: Mi a buk malam un, thuk bangin a lungtang uh lah mansain a bawl ngal ua; jankhuain a hehna uh a ama jingsangin meikuang bangin a kuang hi.
english: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their baker sleeps all the night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

paite: Thuk bangin a sa vek ua, a vaihawmmite uh a negai uh; a kumpipa tengteng uh a pukta uh: kei lama hongpatau kua mah a om kei uhi.
english: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

paite: Ephraim, mite lakah a kidiaha; Ephraim lumlehlouh tanghou beu ahi.
english: Ephraim, he mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

paite: Mikhualten hatna a gai ua, aman a theikei: ahi, a tung koilailai hiamah mulkang a om, a theikei hi.
english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

paite: Huan, Israel kisaktheihnain a mai ah thu a gen hi: hinapiin lah TOUPA a Pathian lamah a kihei kei ua, hiai tengteng jiakin, amah lah a zong kei uh.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.

paite: Huan, Ephraim vakhu hai bang, theihsiamna bei ahi; Aigupta lam a sam ua, Assuria kiangah a pai uh.
english: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

paite: A pai chiang un, a tunguah ka len ka jak ding; vana vasate bangin amau ka kaikhe suk ding: ka sawi dinga, a kikhawmpi un a jaksa bang un.
english: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

paite: A tung uh a gik hi: kei akipanin a tamvakta ngal ua; a tunguah siatna: ka tungah a talekta ngal ua: a maute tat ut leng leng, ka siatna dingin juau a genta uhi.
english: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

paite: A lungtang utoh ka kiang lamah a kap kei ua, a lupna tunguah achiau zosop uh: buhlehbal leh uain zongin a kikaikhawm ua, a tungah a hel uh.
english: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

paite: A khut uh sinsakin hatsakta mahleng, ka siatna dingin a ngaihtuah uhi.A kik ua, himahleh tungsanga ompa kiangah ahi kei; thalpeu gilou bang ahi uh: a lei hehna jiakin namsauin a lalte uh a puk ding uh: Aigupta gamah hiai nuihsana a omna uh ahi ding hi.
english: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

paite: A kik ua, himahleh tungsanga ompa kiangah ahi kei; thalpeu gilou bang ahi uh: a lei hehna jiakin namsauin a lalte uh a puk ding uh: Aigupta gamah hiai nuihsana a omna uh ahi ding hi.
english: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.
